text: Audrey recently got a new tattoo of her four dogs on her arm, because the dogs mean a lot to Audrey and she wants them with her wherever she goes.

Andrew recently went to a farm with his girlfriend to pick up fresh vegetables for dinner, and said the trip was really nice. Andrew asked Audrey whether she would get more fur babies or whether four dogs is enough.
Audrey has four dogs and would like more, but says four is enough for now, because they keep her busy and she wants to give each dog the attention it deserves.
Audrey took all four of her dogs to the vet for check-ups in one visit, which was so chaotic that she plans to bring them one by one next time.
Audrey's four dogs each have a favourite spot: Pepper loves lounging on the couch, Pixie always curls up in her bed, Precious has her chair, and Panda loves to relax on his rug.
Andrew's dog Toby likes to relax on a fluffy blanket on the floor, and Andrew shared a photo of Toby at his favourite spot in the session of 16 August 2023.
Audrey's dogs often snuggle together on Audrey's favourite blanket on the couch, and they always sleep cuddled up together, especially at nap time, which makes them best friends according to Audrey.
Audrey said her dogs mean the world to her, that she cannot imagine life without them, and that seeing them together makes her very happy.
Andrew said he cannot imagine life without his pets, which feel like family to him, and Audrey agreed that pets are family and that the connection between them is sweet.
Audrey shared a photo of herself lying on the grass with two of her dogs in a field on a day outside, which she described as a great day with tons of fun.

Andrew took a break from work on 18 August 2023 to check out a new cafe, a change that reminded him the great outdoors always offers peace, and he shared a photo of a sunset over a mountain from his last hike.
Audrey learned dog grooming in August 2023 by taking a dog grooming course, and she now grooms her own dogs, which makes her feel closer to them.
Audrey's dog grooming tips are to groom slowly and gently, paying attention to sensitive areas like ears and paws, and to stay patient and positive throughout the grooming process.
Andrew said he has always wanted to learn dog grooming but never had the time, and that he would remember Audrey's tips if he ever groomed his dog Toby.
Audrey takes her dogs for a stroll in the park on weekends, which the dogs love and which is a good workout for both Audrey and the dogs, as stated on 19 August 2023.
Andrew planned to visit a nature reserve on the weekend of 19 August 2023 to reconnect with the outdoors, and promised to take photos to show Audrey when he returned.
Andrew and his girlfriend went fishing in one of the nearby lakes on the weekend of 19 August 2023, catching a few fish and having a blast.
Audrey had never been fishing before, but recalled sitting by a gorgeous mountain lake with friends a few years earlier, where the birdsong, still water and fresh air felt very peaceful.
Audrey's regular grooming routine for her dogs includes daily brushing, regular baths, nail trims and plenty of love, which Audrey said keeps them healthy and happy.
Audrey said her dogs mean the world to her, that she wants to make them as happy as possible, and that she and her dogs have a strong bond.
Andrew said he hopes to build a strong bond with his dog Toby, and Audrey advised that building a bond takes time and should not be rushed.
Audrey offered to give Andrew tips on caring for Toby in the session of 24 August 2023, but Andrew said he would try to figure it out on his own first.
Andrew shared a photo of Toby, a small dog sitting on the floor with a leash, and said he and Toby were going to have a blast exploring outdoors together.
Andrew said work had been tough and stressful since the last conversation, so his outdoor activities had taken a backseat and finding balance had been challenging, as stated on 6 September 2023.
Audrey makes sure to do at least one self-care activity each day, such as treating herself to something nice, and encouraged Andrew to take care of himself and have some fun too.
Andrew adds small self-care moments to his day, like grabbing a coffee in the morning or going for a walk at lunch, which helps him recharge and chill out a little.
Audrey recently organised a doggy playdate with the neighbours' dogs, in the session of 6 September 2023, and said seeing all the tails wagging was so sweet.
Audrey bought new beds for her dogs in the week of 28 August 2023 to give them extra comfort as the weather cooled, and the dogs curl up and snuggle on them as if they are in a cloud.
Andrew went on a hike on the weekend of 2 September 2023 and found it a relief to get away from the city, sharing a photo of the sunset he saw during the hike.
Andrew wants to hike with his dog Toby someday, but as of 6 September 2023 it is difficult because Toby is still so young.
Audrey reminded Andrew that he had mentioned looking for a dog-friendly place to live, and Andrew said he is still searching for one and it has been challenging.

Audrey's dog Precious pulled so hard on her leash at the park on Friday 22 September 2023 that the red retractable leash broke, and Audrey had to chase her down to keep her from running off and getting hurt.
Audrey calmed Precious after the leash incident by petting and hugging her, speaking calmly and walking her slowly, and said the bond feels even stronger after moments like that.
Audrey says building trust with dogs needs patience and regular training, along with giving them time and love and praising their successes.
Audrey's dogs are trained in obedience and know tricks including sit, stay, shake and roll over, which Audrey described as fun and rewarding for both her and the dogs.
Audrey walks her dogs very often, multiple times a day, as exercise and bonding time for them, as stated in the session of 24 September 2023.
Audrey's four dogs are all mutts: two are Jack Russell mixes and two are Chihuahua mixes, as Audrey stated in the session of 24 September 2023.
Audrey has a small garden at home, and in September 2023 her Peruvian Lilies had bright colours and needed only water and enough sun, while her veggie patch was coming along.
Andrew shared a photo of flowers on his balcony that he has been taking care of, and asked whether the Peruvian Lilies were hard to care for, to which Audrey said they are easy to look after.
Audrey said her dogs enjoy running around, exploring and having a great time in the garden, which she described as so adorable in the session of 24 September 2023.
Audrey said her dogs are her only fur babies, with no other furry pals to play with, and that the dogs bring loads of love and happiness and mean everything to her.
Andrew and his girlfriend are going to the beach with Toby in November 2023, which Andrew shared as great news in the session of 1 October 2023.
Audrey and Andrew planned a hike with their dogs for November 2023, and Audrey said the dogs always put a smile on her face and life is not the same without them.
Audrey took her dogs to the nearby dog park on Saturday 30 September 2023, where a big grassy area let them play and shaded spots let Audrey relax, and the dogs had a great time.
Audrey said she has been wanting to try birdwatching and is reading a book about birdwatching guides, and Andrew offered to share his birdwatching advice and plan a birdwatching trip together.
Andrew said he will bring binoculars and a notebook to log the birds on their planned birdwatching trip, and that he has read books about ecological systems.
Andrew said he learned a lot from books about animals, plants and ecosystems and believes humans must look after nature for future generations, which Audrey compared to looking after our house.
Andrew asked in the session of 1 October 2023 whether Audrey recycles, and Audrey said recycling is a crucial step in doing her part for the environment.
Andrew suggested reducing carbon footprints by biking or using public transport, and Audrey said she usually takes public transport and would like to try biking as well.
Andrew offered on 1 October 2023 to show Audrey the best bike routes near the river, which he described as awesome routes that are great for getting outside and soaking up the scenery.
Audrey took her dogs to the beach over the weekend of 30 September 2023 and enjoyed seeing them play in the ocean, and the dogs had a blast swimming.
Andrew said he has not been to the beach in a while and misses being outdoors, and that it is hard to find open spaces in the city and his work-life balance makes hiking more challenging than before.
Andrew said exploring nature was his escape to find peace, and that living and working in the city has left him feeling a void in his heart as of 4 October 2023.
Audrey suggested Andrew get plants for his home or visit a park on weekends to appreciate nature in the city, and Andrew said he would look into getting more plants.
Audrey could not walk her dogs for a time because of a knee injury, which was tough because the dogs bring her so much joy, and she shared a photo of the dogs taken after she started walking again.
Audrey makes jewellery from recycled objects such as bottle caps, buttons and broken jewellery, starting it as a hobby before she began selling pieces to customers.
Audrey donates a portion of her jewellery profits to an animal shelter, which she supports even though she can no longer volunteer there, as stated on 6 October 2023.
Audrey said any hobby can have an impact when used well, and that she is still finding ways to do good and make a difference even when she cannot be at the shelter in person.

Andrew, his girlfriend and Toby had a board game night on Tuesday 10 October 2023 that Andrew described as really awesome, and Andrew later mentioned a Friday night board game session as a nice break.
Audrey recently made cookies to thank her neighbours for their pup-friendly homes, as a way to bring some joy around the neighbourhood, as stated on 13 October 2023.
Andrew planned to visit a cozy cafe on the weekend of 14 October 2023, and said a new spot had just opened the other day with a sick view and vibe.
Audrey asked whether she could bring her pups to the new spot, and Andrew said it might not suit dogs but a great dog park was close by, so they could bring their coffee over there.
Andrew's dog Toby is a German Shepherd who loves cute sweaters and is very active, as Andrew stated on 13 October 2023.
Andrew shared a funny story about his pup chasing a squirrel around a tree at the dog park, while the squirrel just watched from the branches.
Audrey said her dogs hate snow, as they were confused when she took them to a snowy park last winter, and they prefer nice, sunny days playing in the grass.
Audrey said her dogs go crazy for Fetch and Frisbee and love running around and meeting other pups at the park, and could keep running for hours.
Audrey recently had more drawings added to her tattoo of her four dogs at a tattoo parlour, and said that is enough for now unless she decides to get another dog someday.
Andrew said that living in the city he misses nature a lot, and that he tries to visit nearby parks or go on hikes whenever he can, which he finds peaceful and joyful.
Audrey said life had been crazy, so she had not taken her dogs for a walk in a while, and she needs to go on a hike with them because it will be great therapy.
Audrey went to a pet store on Monday 16 October 2023 to buy toys for her dogs, and said seeing them so excited when she got them home made her realise how much she loves them.
Andrew recently adopted another pup from a shelter and named him Buddy, because Buddy is Andrew's buddy and Andrew hopes Buddy and Toby become buddies.
Andrew said Buddy is doing great in his new home but is still getting used to Toby and the new environment, and that Toby needs some time to get along with Buddy.
Andrew and Buddy enjoy walks and checking out new hiking trails together, and Andrew said he will soon take both Buddy and Toby to the trails together.
Audrey and Andrew planned a hike with their furry friends for November 2023, and Andrew said it would be fun with the new addition, Buddy.

Audrey wants to find a spot like the countryside dirt road with a cow that Andrew shared, which is far from the city, and said on 19 October 2023 that she would research an awesome place for the hike.
Andrew and his girlfriend went to a wine tasting on the weekend of 21 October 2023, trying many unique wines, and Andrew said he was surprised how much he enjoyed it.
Audrey had an accident while playing with her pups at the park in the week of 16 October 2023, and she now has a cast on her arm and is managing the dogs' care with one arm.
Andrew recently tried sushi for the first time at a new spot in town that serves it, and said it was great and that he now understands what the hype is about.

Audrey recommended that Andrew try a California or salmon roll first when eating sushi and mix it up with different sauces and dips, and Andrew said he would go with a California or salmon roll and try some sauces.
Audrey said she loves sushi and that there are so many types and flavours to try, and she ordered sushi for dinner on 24 October 2023.
Audrey made an appointment with an animal behaviourist on Wednesday 25 October 2023 because her dogs were not acting normally, and she hoped the visit would help her better understand them.
The animal behaviourist checked the dogs, asked questions, gave Audrey tips and suggested changes to their routine, and Audrey is now using positive reinforcement techniques with them.
Audrey said on 28 October 2023 that her dogs are responding well to the positive reinforcement approach and she sees some progress, though the problems will not be fixed immediately.

Audrey said Pepper and Panda are Lab mixes and Precious and Pixie are Chihuahua mixes, which differs from her earlier description on 24 September 2023 of two Jack Russell mixes and two Chihuahua mixes.
Andrew suggested a hike with Audrey on Saturday 4 November 2023 at a dog-friendly trail close by with killer views, and Audrey agreed to pick a date and go hiking.
Andrew said he has a picnic date with his girlfriend on Sunday 5 November 2023, the day after the planned Saturday hike with Audrey.
Audrey and Andrew agreed to hike a trail by a lake with great views, and Andrew said there is a lake near the trail, which Audrey then found a photo of online.
Andrew suggested hiking a trail with autumn colours on a later trip, and Audrey said the autumn colours would look awesome for pictures with the dogs.
Andrew and his girlfriend went on a bike ride and found a cool park outside town over the weekend before 4 November 2023, which Andrew said was awesome for getting away from the city.
Audrey joined a dog owners group to learn how to better take care of her four pups, and meets other dog owners once a week for tips and so the dogs can play together.
Andrew was considering getting another dog but was not yet sure, because two dogs were already a lot to care for, and Audrey advised him to take care of Toby and Buddy first.
Andrew said he has managed to make it work with dogs while living in the city, and Audrey advised that keeping city dogs active is key, through daily socialising, exercise and mental stimulation.
Audrey keeps her dogs mentally stimulated with puzzles, training and hide-and-seek, and Andrew said he would try those activities with his pups.
Audrey took her dogs to the pet salon on Friday 17 November 2023, where they were so excited that their tails wagged like crazy, and they looked great with shiny coats after grooming.
Andrew said he and his girlfriend have not yet had the chance to take their dogs to a groomer, but they plan to do so soon.
Andrew and his girlfriend adopted another dog named Scout the other day, a pup Andrew said fits their adventurous spirit.
Andrew and his girlfriend bought essentials for Scout, including a bed, toys and puppy pads, and are keeping Scout on a leash while Scout gets used to being outside.
Andrew plans to take Scout, Toby and Buddy together to a nearby park that is not big, so they can have fun and get fresh air, as Scout's first adventure.
Audrey advised introducing Scout slowly to Toby and Buddy, starting small and gradually giving them more exposure, while keeping Scout leashed.
Audrey said as of 22 November 2023 her dogs are doing great, exploring and meeting new people, and they feel loved and safe.
